assessment_objectives.objective: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-specific policies, standards and procedures are developed and documented.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-specific policies, standards and procedures are implemented and operating as written.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) operations are conducted according to documented policies, standards, procedures and/or other organizational directives.
documented resourcing decisions allocate the people, processes, technologies, data and facilities needed to support Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) operations.
